start.name: Kima (KIMA chemical/fertilizer complex settlement), Aswan Governorate

proposed_sheet.RouteNotes: Straight-line corridor between two independently sourced named endpoints: the KIMA industrial complex at Kima, Aswan Governorate, and Aswan city. Great-circle 4.24 km vs sheet length 4.0 km (+6%). Endpoint coordinates are OSM place/way centroids (way/98332273 for Kima; node/1667671341 for Aswan city), not surveyed plant-gate or station points. No source gives literal pipeline coordinates; corroborated corridor only. See P8073 for the open identity/length question between these two Aswan-Kima records.

candidates.researcher_notes: Sourced endpoints: kimaegypt.com (official KIMA project page, live) confirms the plant's Aswan-Governorate location and its 1.2 Mm3/d @ 25 bar gas requirement delivered via a filtration/reduction plant; ammoniaenergy.org (live) independently states gas reaches KIMA at Aswan by pipeline from the north via Assiut; youm7.com (live) reports gas reaching Aswan governorate in 2009 as KIMA's lifeline. Tier: medium (corroborated corridor, 2+ independent sources on existence, none on geometry).

start.name: Abu Sultan Power Station (محطة كهرباء أبو سلطان البخارية), Ismailia Governorate — East Delta Electricity Production Company

end.name: Shabab Power Station (محطة كهرباء الشباب), near Tell El Kebir, Ismailia Governorate — East Delta Electricity Production Company

proposed_sheet.RouteNotes: Straight-line corridor between two sourced endpoints. Start = Abu Sultan power station (600 MW, gas-fired, in service 1983); end = Shabab power station (1,500 MW combined-cycle), both East Delta Electricity Production Company assets in Ismailia Governorate, both reported in EEHC's own annual report (moee.gov.eg EEHC_Rep 2017-2018) and both carrying separate Wikidata entries; coordinates geocoded from OSM (ways 105569177 and 124777337), the Abu Sultan point independently cross-checked against a separately-queried OSM landuse=industrial feature 30 m away. Great-circle separation 37.4 km vs the sheet's 38.0 km (98.4%).

candidates.researcher_notes: Endpoints rung of the source ladder, accuracy 'low' — a two-vertex chord, not a surveyed route. The real pipe will follow the Ismailia Canal / Lake Timsah corridor rather than this straight line, so treat the geometry as a corridor placeholder pending a traced route. 'El Shabab' in GEM's name is the Shabab power station, not a generic term: almalnews.com's 2024 GASCO roundup independently names الشباب as one of GASCO's four P.R.M. stations. A contractor page (civecon.com, Petrojet-affiliated) was seen during research explicitly describing an 'Abu Sultan - Shabab Power Plant' gas pipeline project, which would be a third independent corroboration, but the specific project URL could not be re-located and re-verified, so per the no-fabricated-URL rule it is deliberately NOT cited.

start.name: Al-Ma'addiyyah / Boughaz El-Maadia channel at the Lake Idku outlet, near Idku, Beheira Governorate

proposed_sheet.RouteNotes: Schematic chord between sourced endpoints. 'Meadia' in GEM's name is a transliteration of Al-Ma'addiyyah, the channel connecting Lake Idku to Abu Qir Bay — identified from OSM node 768567336 (قلعة المعدية) with the channel's identity and function independently confirmed in Wikipedia's Idku article, which gives no coordinate of its own. End = Damanhur (Wikipedia infobox, corroborated by GeoNames within ~200 m). Chord 38.6 km against the sheet's 50.0 km (ratio 0.77): expected, since the real corridor must skirt Lake Idku and the Abu Qir wetlands rather than cross them — which is also why this is staged schematic rather than 'low'.

candidates.researcher_notes: ONE ITEM FOR UPDATE: the sheet's Start governorate reads 'Damietta', but Al-Ma'addiyyah is at the Idku outlet in BEHEIRA — as is the End (Damanhur). Both ends are Beheira. Not silently corrected; flagged for adjudication. 'Meadia' is a channel, not a governorate or major town, which is the likely origin of the mis-entry. Only one precise-coordinate source exists for the start anchor (the OSM node), so its confidence is medium, not high.
